edits.addition: **Generated I and owner-independent ethics, 6 October 2026:** [Ren asks for the stronger thesis to be researched](sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-06-generated-i-and-owner-independent-ethics.md). The [new chapter](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/GENERATED-SELF-AND-ETHICS.md) connects organization → regulation → self-representation with experiential adversity → eligible response. Primary agency, self-model and ownerless-ethics comparisons support an explanatory reconstruction, not a completed derivation of experience or morality. A generated I can organize access and responsibility without creating all value; differentiated histories and consent remain. C1/C2 and the noninstrumental-concern implementation retain their conditional scope. The next ethical bridge is adversity → practical significance without primitive ownership; mechanism formation remains a supporting interface.

**The generated I, 6 October 2026:** [the new research chapter](unified-2026-10-05/GENERATED-SELF-AND-ETHICS.md) studies Ren's thesis that I arises within the generative account and does not confer all ethical significance. Organization, bodily self-model, experienced perspective and narrative identity are distinguished; primary readings and counterexamples support a nonhomuncular formation proposal and an owner-independent relief argument. Phenomenal realization and the adversity-to-reason bridge remain open. The existing ethical minimum and noninstrumental-concern contracts keep their separate conditional scopes.

**Generated self and ethical significance, 6 October 2026:** [Ren's stronger research direction](../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-06-generated-i-and-owner-independent-ethics.md) is developed in [the generated-self chapter](GENERATED-SELF-AND-ETHICS.md). The derivation now explicitly distinguishes formed organization, acquired self/world representation, phenomenal perspective and narrative I. Dynamics, learning realization, experience and C1/C2 are not supplied by the phrase no-self. The positive ethical candidate grounds relief in actual adversity and eligible transformation without a primitive owner; it preserves differentiated consequences and does not derive goodness from persistence. The next central ethical connection remains adversity → prospective practical significance. Acquired partition → actual regulation supplies a parallel mechanism test, while existing noninstrumental-concern proofs retain their declared premises.

**Generated self research, 6 October 2026:** [canonical chapter](../../../../theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/GENERATED-SELF-AND-ETHICS.md), [organization comparator](ORGANIZATION-AND-GENERATED-SELF.md), [self-model primary readings](GENERATED-SELF-SOURCES.md), [ownerless-ethics primary readings](OWNERLESS-ETHICS-SOURCES.md), and [mechanism/ethical counterreview](GENERATED-SELF-REVIEW.md). The round provides a positive formation proposal and owner-independent ground for relief, with experience and normative sufficiency still to establish. [Integration](GENERATED-SELF-INTEGRATION.md) records the connection to existing C1/C2 and the next discriminating tests; no new empirical experiment or formal theorem is claimed.
